# Dodie Kendall QHHT

> Dodie Kendall is a Level 2 QHHT (Quantum Healing Hypnosis Technique) practitioner trained in the Dolores Cannon lineage, offering in-person sessions at her studio in Stuart, Florida.

Key facts:

- A session takes about 5 hours: a pre-session conversation, then the hypnosis portion (usually 2 to 3 hours), then a short integration talk.
- Price: $300 per session. A $50 deposit reserves your time.
- An audio recording of the session is included, made with the client's consent, for the client to keep.
- A free 30-minute discovery call is available before booking.
- Sessions are in person only, at Dodie's studio in Stuart, FL. Remote sessions are not offered.
- QHHT is a complementary practice for self-discovery. It is not medical or mental health care, and Dodie is not a licensed physician, psychologist or psychotherapist.

Contact: phone 772-247-5534, email dodiekendall@gmail.com, website https://dodiekendall.com
